# Step 00 — Step-by-Step Instructions

**Generated reference — do not edit this file.**

## Orientation

- Origin: front-left corner of the finished board top.
- +X: right. +Y: rear/toward the arm. +Z: up.
- Confirm FRONT and +Y/rear before placing a part, device, template, or tag.

## Record all three route decisions before printing

Record an explicit `yes` or `no` for all three routes before releasing route-dependent jobs. Run exactly one command from each row; do not rely on a default value.

| Decision | Select this route | Do not select this route |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Phone stylus tool | `python scripts/record_print_measurement.py --route phone_stylus_route --selected yes` | `python scripts/record_print_measurement.py --route phone_stylus_route --selected no` |
| Keyboard rod tool | `python scripts/record_print_measurement.py --route keyboard_rod_route --selected yes` | `python scripts/record_print_measurement.py --route keyboard_rod_route --selected no` |
| Fixed-mast camera fallback only (not the arm-camera route) | `python scripts/record_print_measurement.py --route camera_mast_optional --selected yes` | `python scripts/record_print_measurement.py --route camera_mast_optional --selected no` |

At least one tool route—`phone_stylus_route` or `keyboard_rod_route`—must be `yes`. `camera_mast_optional` refers only to the independent fixed eye-to-hand fallback, never the intended arm-mounted camera. Its `yes` value records qualification scope only; it does not authorize printing. Jobs 03C3, 06, 07A, and 07B remain blocked until `fixed_camera_fallback_architecture_released` is PASS against the exact controlled camera-decision hash.

## Phase 00.1 — Decide and initialize

Read PRINT_READINESS.md; select one or both tool routes; record camera_mast_optional only as the independent fixed-mast fallback qualification scope, not as the intended arm-camera route or print authorization; run `python scripts/set_active_build.py --build-id YYYY-MM-DD_CELL-A`, regenerate this package, then run `python scripts/initialize_step_evidence.py --step 00` exactly once before recording any measurement or QIDI file.

## Phase 00.2 — Measure real hardware before diagnostics

Record the exact keyboard; phone/case; side buttons, camera bump, glass edge, and cable/connector envelope; camera mount and blind-thread depth; RoArm gripper; spring; pins; inserts; nuts; screws; washers; board blank; factory clamp footprint; material lots; nozzle; printer; and measurement-tool IDs in the active-build evidence and canonical measurement workflow. First set the required shared context with `python scripts/record_print_measurement.py --context operator=NAME --context date=YYYY-MM-DD --context printer_serial=SERIAL --context measurement_tool_id=CALIPER_ID --context "evidence_directory=BUILD_BY_STEP/00 - Measure Hardware and Print Approved Parts/06 - SAVE MEASUREMENTS AND PHOTOS/BUILD_ID_HERE" --context qidi_studio_version=VERSION`, replacing every uppercase placeholder. Obtain responsible engineering approval IDs for the phone no-go margin, phone TPU proof, and every selected tool-route proof before accepting dependent measurements or coupons.

1. Phase 00.2A — Select one board drill guide: use output/pdf/RC03_BOARD_DRILL_GUIDE_LETTER_1TO1.pdf for a normal Letter printer, or output/pdf/RC03_BOARD_DRILL_GUIDE_24X36_FULL_SIZE_1TO1.pdf only when a print shop can produce one true 24 x 36 inch sheet. Do not combine pages from the two guides. For the Letter guide, pages 1-3 are reference pages marked not for drilling and pages 4-12 are the nine 1:1 tiles; print one-sided, at Actual Size / 100 percent, with no Fit, Shrink, Crop, borderless enlargement, or duplex option. Assemble the 3 x 3 field with the printed 12 mm overlaps and matching registration IDs; never butt paper edges or printer margins. For the full-size guide, print the single page at Actual Size / 100 percent on 24 x 36 inch media without scaling. Measure the independent X and Y 100 mm controls on every physical drilling sheet with a steel rule; each must measure 100.0 +/- 0.2 mm. Verify all matching registration marks on a tiled guide, or the board-edge/orientation controls on the full-size guide. Save ruler and registration/edge photos in the active-build Step 00 evidence folder. From the project root, set `$guidePath="output/pdf/RC03_BOARD_DRILL_GUIDE_LETTER_1TO1.pdf"` or the full-size path, then run `$guideHash=(Get-FileHash $guidePath -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant(); $layoutHash=(Get-FileHash config/workcell_layout.json -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()` and `python scripts/record_print_measurement.py --gate board_setup_template_scale_pass --status PASS --value template_revision=RC03-INT-R1 --value "selected_guide_path=$guidePath" --value "selected_guide_sha256=$guideHash" --value "source_layout_sha256=$layoutHash" --value x_scale_bar_mm=100.0 --value y_scale_bar_mm=100.0 --value "page_scaling_setting=Actual Size / 100 percent" --value all_sheet_registration_marks_result=PASS --evidence-note "Step 00 evidence: ruler and registration/edge photos for the selected drill guide"`, replacing both numeric values with the actual worst-case readings. A scale-control PASS checks print scale only; it is not a released hand-transfer position tolerance and does not replace the independent center audit or full station dry fit in Step 01.

## Phase 00.3 — Print diagnostics first

Print required jobs 00A, 00B, 00C, 00E, and 00F in order with the exact profile on each job card. Print job 00D only when `phone_stylus_route` is explicitly selected. The as-built 00B nut and cable-saddle features are superseded screening evidence and do not qualify the revised interfaces.

2. Phase 00.3A — Print Job 03C1 before Job 03A: after its listed prerequisites pass, print the small production-equivalent phone rail. On the loose rail, bench-qualify both redesigned captive-nut seats with the actual M4 nuts and screws, then feed the adopted nominal 4.8 mm tie around the actual USB cable through the 5.6 x 2.2 mm saddle. This is the authorized production first-article path; no separate replacement nut or tie coupon is required.
3. Save every diagnostic native QIDI project and layer-preview capture inside the Step 00 build-ID evidence folder. The canonical --qidi-job recording option is reserved for non-diagnostic release jobs.
4. Measure every coupon objectively and record raw values, units, instrument IDs, and evidence. If an accepted selection changes geometry, apply the controlled override and regenerate CAD, drawings, plates, readiness, tracker, job cards, and this step package.
5. Record and transfer the seam round-socket diameter, seam radial-slot width, phone-station M3 pocket diameter, and compliant-tool M3 pocket diameter independently. If any accepted value is not represented by its dedicated CAD parameter, stop and regenerate before production.

## Phase 00.4 — Validate release

Run the readiness validator after all measurement updates. A geometry-only 3MF and a digitally valid package are not permission to print a WAITING or NOT_SELECTED job.

## Phase 00.5 — Slice and print released jobs

Open each READY plate in QIDI Studio at 100 percent scale; do not auto-orient, globally scale, merge, or alter the object count.

6. Save the native QIDI Studio project and record QIDI version, profile revision, object count, critical layer-preview acceptance, mass, time, and project hash before starting the printer.
7. Print first articles before dependent production jobs: Job 03C1 before Job 03A, master before slave, first TPU tip before its batch, and mast first article before an optional second foot.

## Phase 00.6 — Inspect and kit

Cool, inspect, measure, label, and kit accepted parts. Quarantine anything warped, cracked, bridged shut, dimensionally out of limit, or untraceable.

8. Reconcile every accepted part, spare, fastener, device, and tool against JOB_KITS.csv, then confirm every Step 01-15 kit is staged before board fabrication begins.

## STOP

> Do not fabricate the board or install a station while any required core job is WAITING, any first article is unaccepted, any actual-device measurement is missing, or any independently selected coupon value is not represented by its dedicated CAD parameter.
